commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then	
  listado  -e C0_ANVL_EQUITIES | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_Default_Equity -t 083000 -
else
  listado  -e C0_ANVL_EQUITIES | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_Default_Equity -t 083000 -
fi
jobDescription: This is a command execution job! It executes a script and possible has some parameters passed to it.
